sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
பதறியே ஓடி வந்தாலும் பலவிதமாய்
கதறியே அழுதாலும் கருணை புரியாயோ
sections.translit:
padhaRiyE Odi vandhAlum palavidhamAy
kadhaRiyE azhudhAlum karuNai puriyAyO
sections.en: Devi, even if I were to come running to you weeping in desperation, would you not show mercy toward me?

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
சிதறியே வினைகள் சீர்கெடச் செய்யாமல்
உதறியே ஏழையைத் தள்ளிடலாமோ
sections.translit:
sidhaRiyE vinaigaL sIrkedach cheyyAmal
udhaRiyE Ezhaiyaith thaLLidalAmO
sections.en: Would you callously cast aside this poor soul, ignoring my pleas to remove all my past sins?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
அரும்பியே முறுவலும் முகமதில் படராதோ
துரும்பினைப் போலவே துயர்களும் தொலையாதோ
கரும்பினை ஏந்திய கரமலர் தான் குவியாதோ
விரும்பியே விழிகளும் அருள் மழை பொழியாதோ
sections.translit:
arumbiyE muRuvalum mugamadhil padarAdhO
thurumbinaip pOlavE thuyargaLum tholaiyAdhO
karumbinai Endhiya karamalar dhAn kuviyAdhO
virumbiyE vizhigaLum aruL mazhai pozhiyAdhO
sections.en: Would not a smile grace your face? Would not all my suffering vanish like dust? Would the hand that holds the sugarcane not display a gesture of compassion? Would your eyes not shower mercy, moved by your desire to help this soul?

notes: This song is addressed to Sri Raja Rajeswari, also known as Kamakshi Amman of Kanchi, who holds a sugarcane in her hand. The song is a plea for her compassion, for the divine hand holding the cane to extend in a gesture of mercy to bless the devotee, who stands tormented by past actions and the sufferings that accompany them.
